title: Death
description: Represents essential endings, transformation, major change, and making room for new beginnings. It's about the end of a phase, not physical death.
meanings: End of a job, radical career direction change.
End of a relationship, transition to a new form.
uprightMeanings: An inevitable and necessary ending.
The need to let go of the old to start anew.
A process of great transformation and change.
reversedMeanings: Fear of small changes, standing still.
Painful prolongation of a necessary ending.
advices: Embrace change and let go of what no longer serves you.
Trust that endings lead to new beginnings.
Use this time for personal transformation.

title: Judgement
description: Represents rebirth, reflection, important decisions, and forgiveness. Facing the consequences of past actions.
meanings: An important job offer, career evaluation.
Making a final decision about a relationship.
uprightMeanings: Facing the consequences of your past actions.
A great calling or a decision that will change your life.
Rebirth and self-forgiveness.
reversedMeanings: Self-blame, doubt, and fear of judgment.
Postponing or refusing an important decision.
advices: Reflect on your past actions and learn from them.
Be ready for a fresh start.
warnings: Don't ignore lessons from your past.

title: Justice
description: Represents justice, balance, truth, and legal matters. The card of cause and effect.
meanings: Honesty, equality, and balance in relationships.
uprightMeanings: Fair outcomes, honesty, and the emergence of truth.
A legal matter resolving in your favor.
Being responsible for your actions and maintaining balance.
reversedMeanings: Making wrong decisions or avoiding responsibility.
advices: Consider all sides before making decisions.
warnings: Dishonesty will catch up with you.

title: The Star
description: Symbolizes hope, inspiration, renewal, and serenity. Feeling blessed by the universe.
meanings: Creativity: New ideas, optimism about the future.
uprightMeanings: Return of hope and inspiration.
Healing, peace, and spiritual tranquility.
A bright and optimistic view of the future.
reversedMeanings: Hopelessness, pessimism, and lack of faith.
advices: Stay optimistic and trust the universe.
warnings: Don't disconnect from your spiritual side.

title: Strength
description: Represents inner strength, courage, compassion, and patience. Using internal rather than external strength.
meanings: Health/Spirit: Physical and spiritual strength, confidence.
uprightMeanings: Overcoming challenges with inner strength and courage.
Managing a difficult situation with patience and compassion.
Facing fears and increasing self-confidence.
reversedMeanings: Lack of self-confidence, weakness, or fear.
Misusing power or applying brute force.
warnings: Don't use force to solve problems.

title: Temperance
description: Represents balance, moderation, patience, and harmony. The need to blend different aspects of life.
uprightMeanings: Perfect balance between different aspects of life.
Progress with patience and moderation, avoiding extremes.
Successful combination of different ideas and energies.
reversedMeanings: Imbalance, excess, and lack of moderation.
advices: Seek balance in all areas of life.

title: The Devil
description: Represents attachment, material traps, addictions, and feeling restricted. Usually self-imposed limitations.
uprightMeanings: Facing material addictions and restrictions.
The need to break free from self-created bondage.
Becoming aware of fear and your shadow self.
reversedMeanings: Breaking free from addictions and liberation.
warnings: Don't let material things control you.

title: The Emperor
description: Represents authority, structure, control, and the father figure. A card of establishing order and discipline.
meanings: Leadership position, rule-maker, building a solid structure.
Finance/Health: Financial security, disciplined health regime.
uprightMeanings: Taking charge of discipline, logic, and control.
Emergence of a strong leadership and authority figure.
Building structures for long-term stability and security.
reversedMeanings: Disregard for rules, lack of discipline, or weak leadership.
Destructive power, acting with ego instead of logic.

title: The Fool
description: Represents new beginnings, innocence, adventure, and stepping into the unknown. Purity and unlimited potential.
meanings: Starting a new venture, taking risks.
uprightMeanings: Being ready for new beginnings, stepping into the unknown.
Optimism, innocence, and unlimited potential.
Enjoying life, being spontaneous and free.
reversedMeanings: Fear of taking risks, wasting potential.
Making a wrong decision or inappropriate naivety.

title: The Hanged Man
description: Calls for a different perspective, sacrifice, postponement, and surrender. Suspended action.
uprightMeanings: The need to look at a situation from a different perspective.
Voluntary sacrifice or postponing action.
Surrender and letting go of control.
reversedMeanings: Wasting oneself, trying to control the situation.
Refusing to learn an important lesson.
warnings: Don't refuse to learn life's lessons.

title: The Hermit
description: Represents solitude, introspection, seeking, and quest for wisdom. The need to withdraw from the external world.
meanings: Learning/Seeking: Seeking guidance, deep thinking, contemplation.
uprightMeanings: Withdrawal for introspection, solitude, and personal growth.
A spiritual quest or finding guidance.
Seeking wisdom and inner truth.

title: The Hierophant
description: Represents tradition, institutions, spiritual guidance, and conformity. Following rules to find the right path.
meanings: Tradition, institution, religious or spiritual guidance.
uprightMeanings: Receiving formal counseling or guidance.
Adapting to traditional values and institutions.
An important ritual, wedding, or spiritual ceremony.
reversedMeanings: Desire to create your own rules, dogmatism.

title: The High Priestess
description: Represents mystery, intuition, the unknown, and passive knowledge. Indicates that you need to trust your instincts.
meanings: Health/Spirit: Inner wisdom, meditation, hidden truths.
A secret relationship, intuitive bond, emotional depth.
uprightMeanings: Trust your intuition, listen to your inner voice.
Hidden information or secrets waiting to emerge.
Time for passivity, silence, and deep reflection.
reversedMeanings: Hidden enemies, secrets coming to surface.
Excessive passivity, lack of knowledge, or wrong intuitions.

title: The Magician
description: Represents potential, action, resources, and willpower. Time to use your talents.
meanings: Starting a new project, showcasing talents, entrepreneurship.
A charming new relationship, willingly starting a relationship.
uprightMeanings: The power to take action, having talent and resources.
The right time for new beginnings, self-confidence.
Masterful use of willpower and intelligence.

title: The Moon
description: Represents fear, illusion, the subconscious, and intuition. Situations are not clear and there is doubt.
uprightMeanings: Fear, subconscious worries, and illusions.
Situations are unclear, confusion and doubt.
Hidden enemies or deceptions.

title: The Sun
description: Represents joy, success, vitality, and confidence. The brightest and most positive aspects of life.
uprightMeanings: Absolute success, joy, and positive energy.
Clarity, brightness, and increasing confidence.
A period when everything is going well.
reversedMeanings: Lack of joy, pessimism, or self-doubt.
Inability to see an important truth.
warnings: Don't let pessimism dim your spirit.

title: The Tower
description: Represents sudden destruction, fundamental change, crisis, and liberation. A necessary awakening.
meanings: Shock: Collapse of life's basic structures.
uprightMeanings: A sudden and destructive crisis or change.
Destruction of structures that no longer work.
A necessary awakening and liberation.

title: Wheel of Fortune
description: Represents fate, luck, cycles, and turning points. A major turning point in your life.
uprightMeanings: Good luck, fate turning in your favor.
A major turning point or significant change.
Karmic events and completion of cycles.
advices: Seize opportunities when luck favors you.
Trust that the wheel always turns.
warnings: Prepare for life's ups and downs.

title: The Chariot
description: Represents willpower, victory, control, determination, and swift progress. Reaching the goal by overcoming obstacles.
meanings: Business trip, rapid career progress, success.
uprightMeanings: Victory of will, achieving success by overcoming obstacles.
Determined and swift progress toward your goal.
Progress through self-control and discipline.
reversedMeanings: Lack of direction, losing control, or defeat.
Inability to establish balance and inner conflicts.

title: The Empress
description: Symbolizes fertility, motherhood, creativity, sensuality, and the power of nature. Represents abundance and growth.
meanings: Finance/Creativity: Material abundance, growth in creative projects.
uprightMeanings: Enjoying abundance and prosperity, a period of growth.
Fertility (ideas, art, or baby), creativity.
Self-care, enjoying luxury and comfort.
reversedMeanings: Creative block, scarcity, or financial problems.
Excessive dependence on others or neglect.

title: The Lovers
description: Represents love, relationships, values, and an important choice. Symbolizes the decision between two paths.
meanings: A deep love bond, soulmate, sexual harmony.
Decision: Making an important choice, crossroads.
uprightMeanings: Love, harmony, and perfect union.
Making a big and important choice from the heart.
A test of your values and beliefs.
reversedMeanings: Incompatibility, conflict, or end of relationship.
advices: Make choices aligned with your values.
warnings: Avoid making decisions based on desire alone.

title: The World
description: Represents completion, success, wholeness, and harmony. The end of a cycle and celebration.
meanings: End of Cycle, Success, Reward, Celebration.
uprightMeanings: Success and reaching goals, completion of a cycle.
Wholeness, harmony, and connection with the universe.
Happy ending of a long journey or project.
reversedMeanings: Inability to reach goals or feeling inadequate.

title: Ace of Cups
description: Symbolizes the beginning of emotional abundance, new love, or spiritual awakening. Your heart overflowing.
meanings: New and deep love, emotional fulfillment, great joy.
Inspiration in creative projects, passion for work.
Finance/Health: Emotional healing and balance, generosity.
Intuition, Inner Peace, New Emotional Beginnings.
uprightMeanings: New beginnings, great joy, and emotional excitement.
Deep happiness and spiritual fulfillment.
Love, compassion, and healing power.
reversedMeanings: Suppressed emotions, emotional blockages, or disappointment.
Feeling of inner emptiness or not receiving love in return.
Emotional overflow, hypersensitivity, or love becoming toxic.

title: Two of Cups
description: Represents unity, harmony, partnership, and mutual attraction. A loving relationship or agreement.
meanings: Strong attraction, new love, soulmate connection.
uprightMeanings: Mutual love, respect, and harmony.
A strong partnership or union.
Creating spiritual and emotional bonds.
reversedMeanings: Problems in partnership, lack of mutual respect.

title: Three of Cups
description: Represents celebration, friendship, community, and success. Time to celebrate success with friends.
meanings: Successful completion of project and team celebration.
uprightMeanings: Celebration, joy, and good friendships.
Sharing success and social harmony.
Productivity and reaching goals.

title: Four of Cups
description: Symbolizes saturation, indifference, or reluctance toward new offers. Ignoring an offered opportunity.
meanings: Boredom in a relationship, emotional stagnation.
Reluctance toward new job offers, lack of motivation.
Finance/Health: Indifference to financial matters, low energy.
uprightMeanings: Indifference, boredom, and saturation.
Rejecting new offers or opportunities.
Reluctance to take action to improve the situation.
reversedMeanings: Embracing a new opportunity and feeling energetic.
Breaking free from complacency and opening up to surroundings.

title: Five of Cups
description: The card of loss, grief, and regret. Usually about focusing on three spilled cups and not seeing two still standing.
meanings: Mourning after separation, regret, missing the past.
Finance/Health: Financial losses, inability to focus on recovery.
uprightMeanings: Loss and sorrow, being stuck in the past.
Missing opportunities or not appreciating what you have.
Need to accept the period of sorrow and regret.
reversedMeanings: Accepting the loss and beginning to heal.
Finding hope again and looking forward.
Peaceful resolution of a past relationship or situation.

title: Six of Cups
description: Represents the past, nostalgia, childhood, and innocence. Symbolizes a gift or person from the past.
meanings: A love from the past, childhood friend, nostalgia.
Memories: Longing for the past, childhood memories.
uprightMeanings: Beautiful memories from the past and nostalgia.
Reuniting with an old friend or love.
Being generous and doing good.
reversedMeanings: Being stuck in the past, refusing to progress.
Restlessness, difficulty breaking free from the past.

title: Seven of Cups
description: Represents options, dreams, illusions, and confusion. Unrealistic expectations.
uprightMeanings: Countless options and difficulty making decisions.
Unrealistic dreams and illusions.
Getting lost among possibilities.
reversedMeanings: Setting a realistic goal and taking action.
Breaking free from a major illusion.

title: Eight of Cups
description: Represents leaving a situation, relationship, or place due to emotional dissatisfaction. Search for deeper meaning.
meanings: Deciding to end an unsatisfying relationship.
Leaving a career that no longer has meaning.
Finance/Health: Feeling of inner emptiness despite financial situation.
Departure, Fatigue, Search for Something More Meaningful.
uprightMeanings: Quietly withdrawing from a situation or relationship.
Search for emotional fulfillment and spiritual meaning.
Decision to leave, but it's a choice rather than a necessity.
reversedMeanings: Decision to return or hesitation to leave.
Avoidance or not having the courage to end a situation.
Getting stuck in repeating emotional cycles.

title: Nine of Cups
description: Symbolizes wishes coming true, emotional fulfillment, and happiness. Often known as the 'Wish Card'.
meanings: Great happiness in relationship, finding soulmate.
Success at work, reaching a satisfying position.
Finance/Health: Material comfort and security, good physical health.
uprightMeanings: Wishes coming true and happiness.
Self-confidence and emotional fulfillment.
Feeling good materially and spiritually.

title: Ten of Cups
description: Represents absolute happiness, lasting harmony, family, and the peak of emotional fulfillment. Dreams realized.
uprightMeanings: The highest level of family and emotional happiness.
Lasting harmony and peace.
Emotional completion of your life.

title: Page of Cups
description: Represents emotional news, intuition, artistic inspiration, and creative offers. A young, sensitive person.
meanings: New romantic invitation, a sensitive person.
A creative offer or inspiring idea.
News: An emotional message, intuitive awakening.
uprightMeanings: New emotional news or offer.
Creative inspiration and discovery of artistic talents.
A sensitive, dreamy, and intuitive person.

title: Knight of Cups
description: Represents romance, offers, invitations, and a dreamy action. An emotional messenger.
meanings: A creative job offer or invitation.
News: An emotional offer or invitation.
uprightMeanings: The arrival of an invitation or romantic offer.
Approach of a sensitive, attractive, and romantic person.
Putting creative ideas into action.
reversedMeanings: Wrong offers, disappointment, or emotional confusion.
A person with low mood, pessimistic, or insecure.

title: Queen of Cups
description: Represents intuition, compassion, emotional stability, and artistic talent. A sensitive figure.
meanings: A loving, compassionate, and intuitive woman.
uprightMeanings: A compassionate, loving, and emotionally stable woman.
Strong intuition and psychic abilities.
Providing emotional support to others.

title: King of Cups
description: Represents emotional maturity, compassion, control, and balance. A wise leader figure.
meanings: Leader in art, counseling, or healing fields.
uprightMeanings: Emotional control and maturity.
A compassionate and loving leader or figure.
Ability to manage emotions with wisdom.

title: Ace of Swords
description: Represents mental clarity, new ideas, breakthroughs, and truth. The power of the mind.
meanings: A new business idea, a legal victory.
uprightMeanings: Mental clarity, the birth of a new idea.
Ability to overcome difficulties, victory.
Seeing the truth and honesty.
reversedMeanings: Bad intentions, cruel criticism, or destruction.

title: Two of Swords
description: Represents indecision, deadlock, defense, and avoidance. Avoiding a difficult choice.
uprightMeanings: Facing a difficult choice or indecision.
Defense and emotional withdrawal.
Ignoring emotional truths.
reversedMeanings: Consequences of postponing a difficult decision.

title: Three of Swords
description: Represents sorrow, heartbreak, loss, and betrayal. Emotional pain.
uprightMeanings: A great heartbreak and emotional pain.
Betrayal, separation, or deep loss.
Accepting disappointing truths.
reversedMeanings: Avoiding the cycle of repeated heartbreaks.

title: Four of Swords
description: Represents rest, healing, meditation, and withdrawal. Time to recover before taking action.
uprightMeanings: Rest, healing, and mental recovery.
Introspection before taking action.
Tranquility, silence, and mental peace.

title: Five of Swords
description: Represents defeat, shame, an empty victory, and winning at a cost. A conflict where everyone loses.
uprightMeanings: Defeat or a shameful loss.
A victory won but where everyone loses.
Disagreement, bad intentions, or conflict.
reversedMeanings: Learning from defeat and forgiving yourself.

title: Six of Swords
description: Represents moving away from a difficult situation, transition, healing, and travel. Moving toward better waters.
meanings: Moving Away, Escaping a Difficult Situation.
uprightMeanings: Slowly moving away from a difficult situation.
A period of physical or emotional transition.
Healing and progress toward a better future.
reversedMeanings: Delay in transition, avoidance, or returning.

title: Seven of Swords
description: Represents secrecy, deception, trickery, and escaping something. Secretly manipulating a situation.
uprightMeanings: Secrecy, trickery, or deception.
Escaping responsibility or doing things secretly.
Manipulating a situation through dishonest means.
reversedMeanings: Recovering something lost or finding what was stolen.

title: Eight of Swords
description: Represents restriction, victim role, self-limitation, and feeling blocked. Prison of thoughts.
uprightMeanings: Feeling restricted and trapped.
Playing the victim and helplessness.
Mental prison created by negative thoughts.
reversedMeanings: Breaking free from restrictions and liberation.
Abandoning the victim role and taking responsibility.
Gaining a new perspective and seeing obstacles.

title: Nine of Swords
description: Represents worry, nightmares, despair, and anxiety. Mental anguish that seems worse than reality.
uprightMeanings: Great worry, nightmares, and anxiety.
Insomnia and mental anguish.
A situation that seems worse than it actually is.

title: Ten of Swords
description: Represents a sudden and devastating end, defeat, worst-case scenario, and painful ending of a cycle. But also symbolizes beginning.
meanings: Worst-Case Scenario, Defeat, Being a Victim.
uprightMeanings: A sudden and devastating end, betrayal, or heavy loss.
Realization of the worst-case scenario.
Reaching rock bottom and the necessity to start over.
reversedMeanings: Postponement or prolongation of the end.

title: Page of Swords
description: Represents new ideas, curiosity, quick thinking, and verbal communication. A thought messenger.
meanings: News: A mental challenge, careful information.
uprightMeanings: Arrival of new and lively ideas.
A curious, smart, and energetic person.
A challenge that pushes boundaries.
reversedMeanings: Verbal aggression, gossip, or rude words.
Ideas going to waste, lack of concentration.

title: Knight of Swords
description: Represents quick action, assertiveness, haste, and determination. An impulsive and courageous action.
uprightMeanings: Quick and determined action, pushing forward.
Courage and assertiveness.
Risk of acting without thinking.

title: Queen of Swords
description: Represents sharp intelligence, independence, honesty, and judgment. A figure who separates emotions with logic.
uprightMeanings: An independent, sharp-minded, and honest woman.
Non-emotional, logical decision-making.
Speaking the truth clearly and directly.
reversedMeanings: Cruel criticism, coldness, or emotional manipulation.

title: King of Swords
description: Represents intellectual authority, mental discipline, power, and truth. A fair but firm ruler.
uprightMeanings: Intellectual authority and mental clarity.
Disciplined, fair, and logical decision-making.
Success in law or legal matters.

title: Ace of Pentacles
description: Represents a new material opportunity, prosperity, stability, and a concrete beginning. A material gift.
meanings: Finance: New business opportunities, financial gain, security.
A concrete business project, a good start.
uprightMeanings: A new material opportunity or beginning.
Abundance, prosperity, and financial security.
Concrete success potential and stability.
reversedMeanings: Financial loss, missed or cancelled opportunities.
Too much focus on material matters, greed.

title: Two of Pentacles
description: Represents balancing, flexibility, managing priorities, and handling different aspects of life.
meanings: Finance: Balancing budgets, two income sources.
uprightMeanings: Balancing two different situations or responsibilities.
Adapting to life's ups and downs.
Managing priorities and flexibility.

title: Three of Pentacles
description: Represents teamwork, collaboration, showcasing skills, and mastery. Perfecting together.
meanings: Finance: Earnings through collaboration, project approval.
uprightMeanings: Teamwork and successful collaboration.
Appreciation of your talents and striving for excellence.
Getting approval and progress on a project.
reversedMeanings: Incompatibility within the team, competition, or incompetence.

title: Four of Pentacles
description: Represents material security, possession, stinginess, and control. Held assets.
meanings: Stinginess, Need for Control, Setting Boundaries.
uprightMeanings: Material security, saving, and stability.
Possessiveness, stinginess, and need for control.
Setting boundaries and protection.
reversedMeanings: Fear of losing control, closed to new opportunities.

title: Five of Pentacles
description: Represents material loss, poverty, exclusion, and health problems. Feeling excluded.
meanings: Exclusion, Loss, Reluctance to Ask for Help.
uprightMeanings: Financial loss, difficulties, and insecurity.
Feeling excluded, unwanted, or alone.
Inability to see opportunities or help.
reversedMeanings: Improvement of financial situation, new job.
End of a difficult period, renewed hope.

title: Six of Pentacles
description: Represents generosity, charity, balance of giving and receiving. Financial justice.
uprightMeanings: Generosity and charity.
Achieving financial balance, paying debts.
Receiving help from others or helping others.

title: Seven of Pentacles
description: Represents waiting, evaluation, patience, and waiting for investment results. Seeing the fruits of labor.
meanings: Seeing the fruits of labor, project evaluation.
uprightMeanings: Patiently waiting for the fruits of labor.
Evaluating investment results.
Taking a break and reviewing progress.

title: Eight of Pentacles
description: Represents craftsmanship, skill, apprenticeship, and attention to detail. Dedication to self-improvement.
meanings: Apprenticeship, gaining skills, focus on details.
uprightMeanings: Skill, diligence, and dedication to self-improvement.
Attention to details and excellence.
Mastering a craft or job.

title: Nine of Pentacles
description: Represents luxury, self-sufficiency, financial independence, and elegance. Reaping the fruits of labor.
meanings: Finance: Financial independence, luxury, solid investment.
uprightMeanings: Financial independence and success.
Enjoying luxury and comfort.
Confidence, elegance, and self-reliance.

title: Ten of Pentacles
description: Represents lasting wealth, family heritage, stability, and long-term success. Generational wealth.
meanings: Finance: Lasting wealth, inheritance, financial success.
Family: Family tradition, roots, security at home.
uprightMeanings: Lasting financial security and wealth.
Family heritage, traditions, and roots.
Long-term success and stability.
reversedMeanings: Financial loss, family conflict, or lost inheritance.

title: Page of Pentacles
description: Represents new material opportunities, career-related news, learning, and practical skills. A material student.
meanings: Finance: Financial news, new job offers.
Learning a new skill, training opportunity.
uprightMeanings: New material opportunities or career news.
Learning and developing practical skills.
A diligent and focused person.

title: Knight of Pentacles
description: Represents patience, diligence, reliability, and slow progress. Guaranteed but slow success.
uprightMeanings: Patience, diligence, and reliability.
Slow but guaranteed progress and success.
A practical and realistic approach.
reversedMeanings: Delays in progress, taking things too slow.

title: Queen of Pentacles
description: Represents generosity, motherhood, practicality, and material security. A nurturing and successful figure.
meanings: Finance: A financially secure, generous woman.
Family: Maternal, nurturing, comfort at home.
uprightMeanings: A generous, practical, and nurturing woman.
Material security and comfort at home.
Balancing success and family.

title: King of Pentacles
description: Represents material success, business acumen, stability, and power. A successful businessman or manager.
uprightMeanings: Material success, wealth, and stability.
A reliable, successful leader or figure.
Financial security and generosity.

title: Ace of Wands
description: Symbolizes the beginning of creativity, a new venture, or an inspiring idea. A period full of energy and passion.
meanings: New business opportunities, career breakthrough, creative projects.
New excitement entering a relationship, passion, or an energetic beginning.
Finance/Health: Increased energy and vitality, courage to start a new venture in financial matters.
Inspiration, Exciting New Idea, Emergence of Potential.
uprightMeanings: New beginnings, inspiration, and desire to explore.
Gateway to a period of great energy and activity.
Courage to take initiative, passion, and enthusiasm.
reversedMeanings: Delays in projects, obstacles, or lack of inspiration.
Inability to see or capitalize on new opportunities.

title: Two of Wands
description: Represents planning, progress, thinking about the future, and making bold decisions. Merging with the world.
meanings: Planning, creating partnerships, looking to the future.
uprightMeanings: Planning for the future and preparing for progress.
Making bold decisions and exploring new opportunities.
Success potential and control.
reversedMeanings: Fear, delays or obstacles in progress.
Failure of plans, being overly cautious.

title: Three of Wands
description: Represents long-term vision, expansion, opportunities, and progress on solid foundations. First stage of success.
uprightMeanings: Long-term vision and realization of plans.
Expansion, international opportunities.
Progress and success on solid foundations.

title: Four of Wands
description: Symbolizes celebration, harmony, stability, and building a home. Peace following a successful period.
meanings: Successful completion and celebration of a project.
Marriage, engagement, peace and happiness at home.
Finance/Health: Enjoying financial stability, good health.
uprightMeanings: Homecoming, sense of home, and happiness.
Celebration of success and stability.
Harmony, community, and a safe harbor.
reversedMeanings: Postponement of celebrations or family discord.
A planned event ending in failure.

title: Five of Wands
description: Represents minor conflicts, competition, or clashing energies. This is usually a constructive struggle.
meanings: Office competition, idea conflicts, creative tension.
Fun but tiring arguments, minor disagreements.
Collision of Various Views, Friendly Competition.
uprightMeanings: Competition and struggle, but usually leads to constructive results.
Differences of opinion and different approaches within a group.
Need to direct energy toward the right goal.
reversedMeanings: Pointless bickering that leads nowhere and restlessness.
Inability to unite energy to solve a problem.

title: Six of Wands
description: Represents victory, public recognition, success, and confidence. Honor following a challenge.
uprightMeanings: Public victory and recognition.
Success, confidence, and positive results.
Receiving good news and motivation.

title: Seven of Wands
description: Represents challenge, competition, courage, and defending yourself. Standing up against difficulties.
uprightMeanings: Defending yourself against challenges and competition.
Standing firm with courage and perseverance.
Being in a superior position and resisting.

title: Eight of Wands
description: Symbolizes rapid movement, acceleration of events, and sudden communication. Things may develop faster than expected.
meanings: Rapid completion of projects, urgent news, or fast developments.
A relationship suddenly accelerating, fast emotional communication.
Finance/Health: Need to make an important decision quickly, sudden improvements.
uprightMeanings: Speed of action, rapid progress, and acceleration of events.
Removal of all obstacles and free flow toward the goal.
Good news about communication and travel.
reversedMeanings: Delays, frustrating slowdown, or blocked progress.
Errors resulting from impatience and hasty decisions.

title: Nine of Wands
description: Represents resilience, courage, and ability to overcome one final obstacle. Being tired but ready.
meanings: Reaching the final stage of a project, one last resistance.
Being defensive or skeptical in a relationship.
Finance/Health: Showing patience in the healing process, resisting financial difficulties.
One Last Stand, Inner Strength, Protecting Boundaries.
uprightMeanings: Resistance, courage, and not giving up even when close to exhaustion.
Preparing for one last challenge and protecting boundaries.
Learning from experiences and using wisdom.
reversedMeanings: Paranoia, being overly defensive, or distrust.
Succumbing to fatigue and giving up the fight.
Inability to recover from past wounds, wasting energy.

title: Ten of Wands
description: Represents overload, responsibility, pressure, and being weighed down. Time to let go of the burden.
meanings: Need to Let Go of the Burden, Sense of Duty.
uprightMeanings: Overload, responsibility, and being under pressure.
Increased burnout and stress.
Need to let go of the burden you carry.
reversedMeanings: Reaching the end of a project and being freed.

title: Page of Wands
description: Represents exciting news, beginnings, enthusiasm, and an adventurous spirit. An energetic messenger.
meanings: News of a new opportunity, an inspiring idea.
uprightMeanings: New, exciting news or opportunities.
Enthusiasm, creativity, and desire for adventure.
Potential for starting a new path.

title: Knight of Wands
description: Represents a quick, impulsive, and adventurous call to action. Often symbolizes a journey or sudden departure.
meanings: A quick job offer or sudden career change.
A fast-developing, passionate but not lasting relationship.
Finance/Health: Risky investments, accidents due to carelessness.
uprightMeanings: Quick and enthusiastic action, seeking adventure.
A great burst of energy and passionate progress.
News of going somewhere or an important event approaching.
reversedMeanings: Haste, thoughtlessness, and not considering consequences of actions.
Breaking promises, unplanned departures or withdrawal.

title: Queen of Wands
description: Represents charm, confidence, courage, and creativity. An energetic and popular figure.
uprightMeanings: A confident, energetic, and creative woman.
Charm and popularity, inspiring others.
A strong social circle and friendship.

title: King of Wands
description: Represents a charismatic, visionary, and energetic leader. Symbolizes creativity, entrepreneurship, and natural authority.
meanings: A strong leader, visionary boss, or entrepreneur.
